title: Ghost Over Lakeside Lab
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a woman in an orange dress standing beside a large blue steampunk machine emitting smoke, next to a retro orange car on a dock by the water. In the swirling cosmic sky above, a giant glowing purple ghost with a smiling face emerges from a colorful vortex of clouds and planets.
prompt: A woman in a long orange dress stands beside a large blue steampunk boiler machine with pipes and smoke, next to a vintage orange car parked on a dock by a calm lake. In the dramatic night sky, a giant translucent purple ghost with a happy smiling face floats within a swirling colorful cosmic vortex of green, yellow, and purple clouds filled with glowing planets and stars, surreal fantasy scene.
